title: Ordinary direct image respects horizontal coefficient maps
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, f:X→Y a scheme morphism, and M any ordinary coefficient system on X. Use native direct image P_f, ordinary evaluations e_k, and the specified positive coefficient rings A_k [def-sp-varying-ring-operations, def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. For n≤m, let τ_W:e_m^W→e_n^W⋙Res_W be the actual horizontal coefficient transition [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition]. Write ε_k:P_f⋙e_k^Y≅e_k^X⋙P_(f,k) for moduleEvalP. Let d:P_(f,n)⋙Res_Y≅Res_X⋙P_(f,m) be the section-normalized scalar direct-image square [lem-weil-compact-support-open-restriction-scalar]. Then τ_Y,P_f(M) ≫ Res_Y(ε_n,M) ≫ d_(e_n^X(M)) = ε_m,M ≫ P_(f,m)(τ_X,M).

source.place: Tags 03DA and 03D3, naturality under adjunction of module inverse and direct images; Tag 0941, sequence-site horizontal maps. The first transpose in the assigned ordinary-open transition argument.

proof.text: Postcompose both proposed composites with compactSupportDirectModel at level m, evaluated on the restriction of e_n(M). Unfold compactSupportScalarDirectImage, cancel the inverse and forward model comparisons, and use naturality of the level-m model comparison. Both resulting composites are exactly the two sides of compactSupportOrdinaryDirectTransition after expanding compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation. Apply that proved square and cancel the postcomposed isomorphism.

theorem compactSupportOrdinaryDirectImageTransition {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (M : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E X) :
    (compactSupportOrdinaryCoefficientTransition l E Y h).app
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.push (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f).obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).map
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.moduleEvalP (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f n).hom.app M) ≫
      (compactSupportScalarDirectImage f (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).hom.app
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).obj M) =
    (ProEtale.VaryingRing.moduleEvalP (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f m).hom.app M ≫
      (ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleDirectImage
        (compactSupportSystemLevel l E m) f).map
          ((compactSupportOrdinaryCoefficientTransition l E X h).app M)
